messages:
deploybot: Scheduled v2 API rollout for service \"gateway\" at 2024-04-10T15:00Z (in ~2h). Release id r-20240410-v2. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 80% -> 100% every 8m. Operators: @kevin @jen. Please ack. Command: `/deploy r-20240410-v2 --canary --ops-eyes`
maria: Ack. Release notes updated: https://go/release/20240410. Added migration notes for header behavior. @sam can you confirm mobile handling? :mag:
sam: Confirmed — mobile SDK will set `x-api-version: 2` by default in 2.2.0. We'll ship a tiny fallback that sends v1 for legacy installs. ETA ~45m.
jen: Ops plan: start canary in iad on a 10-host subset, then region fade. Health checks: 2xx ratio, p95 latency, and an error-type tag `schema_mismatch` filter. Also ensure deploybot flips `traffic-route` in 2m windows.
kevin: Proposed rollback criteria:
- sustained 5xx rate > 1.5% for 10m OR
- p95 latency regresses by >250ms vs baseline for 15m OR
- migration error `schema_mismatch` >= 50 events in 10m
If triggered: immediate rollback to r-20240305-v1 and open incidents channel + mark deploy as reverted.
alex: Preflight smoke: curl with header then check runtime header. Example:
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -H \"x-api-version: 2\" https://gateway.staging/echo | grep '\"ok\":true' || exit 1
done
```
Expect `x-runtime: redwood` in response headers.
sre-bot: Note: canary alerts created as `canary:v2:anomaly`. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/canary-v2. Auto-notify @oncall if 5xx spike > 0.5% in 5m.
maria: Quick callout — docs section "breaking changes" is empty but we must call out header case-sensitivity tweak. @eng-infra FYI.
jen: I've added a deploybot checklist: `deploybot schedule r-20240410-v2 --ops-eyes` -> operator ack required. I'll start a dry-run 10m before to warm hosts.
kevin: I'll watch /dashboards/v2_rollout and post snapshots at T+5, T+20. If mobile errors spike, hold and escalate immediately.
deploybot: /deploy started (dry-run) r-20240410-v2. Dry-run logs: https://go/logs/r-20240410-dryrun — smoke tests passed.
sam: Note: mobile will intentionally fallback for ~1% of requests without header due to legacy flag distribution. We'll surface them as `client:legacy` so analytics show impact.
maria: Sounds good. If no blockers I'll move this to release channel at +30m. :thumbsup:
jen: Ack. Pinning rollback steps and ops contact numbers in runbook now.
kevin: Oncall alerted. Watching. :eyes:
